rows.input: qualified Pyat current world/source/epoch/as-of/version/N11-N12 permission and Sarok receiver contract

rows.input: exact admitted parent streams, actor state/history, event, concrete issued CAN008 Rule A, scope and valid-empty/no-effect conditions
rows.function: evaluate one exact response rule over the actual readset and produce a response or a lawful no-proposal/deny

rows.falsifier: withhold Rule A -> no proposal/no target; mutate response body/readset -> refusal

rows.receiving_behavior: A later act is shaped by a practice that was actually formed and remains independently durable.
rows.input: exact CAN011 RULE_T, target state/object, before/write sets, CREATE/NO_CHANGE/DENY grant, expiry/revocation and independent later E2

rows.falsifier: self-issued grant or pre-commit E2 -> refusal; no target row on NO_CHANGE/DENY
